thread:
amon: Heads-up — noticed sampled decision logs are showing ACCEPT for requests that full logs show as ROUTE_OVERRIDE -> fallback-model. Repro steps below. :thinking:
Sasha: ugh, that sounds like sampling bias. Do you have an example trace id?
amon: Yep: trace_id=tx-9f2a. Sampled decision log shows rule match A -> route main-model. Full trace (raw) shows main-model matched then header-override rule kicked in and switched to fallback.
tariq: could be KV cache short-circuiting eval in prod and the sampled snapshot was taken before override logic ran. Are we sampling post-eval or pre-eval?
amon: current sampling hook is in gateway pre-routing. So it captures initial rule eval but not the later override stage when header checks run in the router plugin.
jen: that's the problem — our decision-log sampling point is too early for multi-stage policies (prefix rules + header overrides + async priority rules). We need to move sampling to after all policy transforms or capture both stages.
marta: thinking out loud: add a "policy_stage" enum to sampled payload (pre_transform, post_transform, final). Minimal change and should be backwards compatible.
Sasha: agree. Also: sample-replay CLI currently replays only the sampled payloads which wont reproduce the override since payload lacked headers that caused override. We should include request headers + KV cache keys in sample.
amon: example command I used: ```sample-replay --input=samples/2026-11-02.json --target=canary``` returned ACCEPT on canary. If you attach headers file it flips.
tariq: quick fix: toggle decision-log hook to capture post-routing by feature-flag. We can flip for canary customers and re-evaluate telemetry. But we need to ensure overhead is acceptable (extra serialization).
jen: overhead note: post-routing sampling adds ~0.9ms p95 to gateway path in our bench cluster. We can limit to 0.5% sample rate for now.
marta: for longer term, we should make sampled payload referential: include keys: header keys used in routing, cache_key fingerprint, and a small policy-eval diff so replay can run deterministic.
Sasha: also saw that the sampler drops long headers (>1k) which removed the 'x-tenant-policy' header in some traces. We should gzip compress and base64 encode headers in the sample.
amon: created a tiny PR that adds post_transform samples + compressed headers: https://git.internal/redwood/r/PR-4321 — tests added. @sasha can you review? :chefkiss:
Sasha: on it. Quick ask: include the route-match trace array (list of rules evaluated and decisions). Even tiny arrays help.
jen: operational item: update the console decision-log dashboard to surface sample_stage, cache_hit, and header_summary. Right now dashboard groups by rule name only which hides stage mismatches.
tariq: agree — we should also add a rollout metric: fraction of samples where post_transform decision != pre_transform decision by model and by customer-tier. That will help catch regressions during policy rollouts.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary/sampler-adjustments at 2026-11-03T09:15Z (sha: 9f2a1d)
amon: noted. After the canary I will run a focused sample-replay on the affected tenant list and open a small postmortem if divergence > 1%.
marta: one more: let's add a sampling correlation id so we can stitch sampled traces to the broader request trace in observability (trace_id + sample_id). Avoids name collisions.
Sasha: SGTM. I'll leave feedback on the PR re: header compression format and add an integration test that simulates a KV cache hit + header override.
jen: thanks all. Keeping this short — follow-up in eng-platform #sync tomorrow to finalize rollout window. :thumbsup:
